v4_selection.rule: Amendment 5c: adopt I if CV QWK5(I) - QWK5(B) >= +0.010 and LOSO(I) >= LOSO(B) - 0.010; else adopt H under the same two conditions; else B stays. CV QWK5 = the selection table (pooled out-of-fold, both seeds); LOSO = mean QWK5 over the three held-out sources (Shenzhen site fold, Ostrava, ROP-VL), pooled over both seeds; differences of the reported 4-dp numbers. An arm without both seeds or without all three held-out sources is not adoptable.
reasons: I: CV QWK5 I-B = -0.0038 (needs >= +0.010), LOSO I-B = +0.0054 (needs >= -0.010) -> not adopted
H: CV QWK5 H-B = -0.0124 (needs >= +0.010), LOSO H-B = +0.0085 (needs >= -0.010) -> not adopted

note: T and the operating point are per arm-seed (seeds blocks); never averaged. Dev is development-external: every dev number is descriptive, not an endpoint.
